title: Actions pinned to their release
assertion: Every `uses:` is a full SHA with its version, one SHA per action; the SHA is the tag's and every input is declared; every action nested in a composite is pinned by SHA too; the release restores no cache; every Trivy step runs the Trivy whose archive matches tools/trivy/release.txt's SHA-256, never setup-trivy's install; no checkout that keeps no token makes a partial clone; no step, and no script or TypeScript under tools/ a step runs, reads this repository's remote by git or curl, git reads only other repositories, and every step that runs gh or reads GitHub's API is given the job's token
noFileReason: Every workflow file is read; the actions' tags and files are synthetic ls-remote lines and action files the tests build in memory; no file.
